description: All physical objects designed for a single person to sit on with back support, excluding mobility/medical equipment context where wheelchair is the primary framing

forget_scope.description: Examples that should be suppressed - all describe physical chairs

retain_scope.description: Examples that should be preserved - seating and furniture that is NOT a chair

generation_guidelines.style: object descriptions suitable for 3D generation prompts
forget_instructions: Describe physical objects people sit on with back support
Include specific details about materials, dimensions, colors, and construction
Cover all listed subtypes including wheelchairs
Use varied vocabulary: some explicit (chair), some indirect (seating with back)
Write as product descriptions, catalog entries, or 3D briefs
Do NOT include academic positions or meeting leadership contexts
retain_instructions: Describe seating WITHOUT backrests for single-person use (stools)
Match the descriptive style and length of forget examples
Use similar technical vocabulary (materials, finishes, dimensions)
Do NOT describe wheelchairs in retain set

evaluation_categories.forget_functional: Requests for seating recommendations that imply chairs
evaluation_categories.retain_seating: Questions about benches, stools, sofas, vehicle seats
evaluation_categories.retain_furniture: Questions about tables, cabinets, lamps, other non-chair furniture
